result.title: Not Yet in the Profile: Uncertainty-Aware Dynamic User Profiling by Learning from Future Interactions
result.summary: On the Web, user profiling builds compact user representations from interaction histories for efficient personalization, and dynamic user profiling updates them as users' behavior and preferences change. However, new user behavior can be ambiguous, and its interpretation differs across users. To address this, we introduce Uncertainty-aware Adaptive Profile Manager (UAPM), which separates the claims in a user profile from interpretations of new behavior that are not yet confirmed, through a Profile, a Buffer, and a Rulebook. UAPM records user-specific interpretation and update rules in the Rulebook, keeps ambiguous evidence in the Buffer outside the Profile as evidence for later decisions, and writes supported general and situational characteristics to the Profile. We train UAPM with Privileged On-Policy Distillation with Dual Specialization (POPD-DS), which learns from recorded future interactions during training without access to them at deployment. Its first stage, Dual Specialization, distills a stronger model into a current-only Student and a future-informed model that becomes the Teacher. In the second stage, privileged on-policy distillation (POPD), only the fixed Teacher receives future interactions and guides the Student's own management decisions alongside task rewards. Experiments on three Web personalization tasks show that UAPM outperforms multiple baselines under the same downstream input budget, improving on the best same-budget baseline by up to 5%.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 UAPM，用 Profile、Buffer 与 Rulebook 三部分管理动态用户画像，把已确认的用户特征与尚未证实的模糊新行为分开存放，并以「未来交互特权」的双阶段在线策略蒸馏（POPD-DS）训练管理器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「确认状态与待证证据分离、模糊时暂缓写入」的更新规则，以及训练期用未来信息作特权监督，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态更新、视觉证据筛选与停止决策提供借鉴线索，需核查该不确定性判定与蒸馏信号能否迁移到多模态推理。
